slides.title: AtlasOS
content: Autonomous AI Operating System for On-Chain Finance
Non-custodial, auditable automation — optimized for HashKey Chain
Contact: emotionalcoders@gmail.com
Website: https://atlas-os-defi-ai-haskey.lovable.app/
slides.notes: One-line intro: AtlasOS runs autonomous, auditable AI agents to manage risk, yield, liquidations and treasury operations on-chain. Today I'll walk through the problem, our solution, architecture, AI design and GTM.

slides.title: Executive Summary
content: What AtlasOS is: AI agent network + policy engine + on-chain enforcement
Problem: DeFi ops are manual, 24/7, and risky — treasury & protocol teams need automation
Solution: Composable agents for risk, yield, liquidations, treasury with governance-first controls
Vision: The AI OS for on-chain finance — enterprise-grade, auditable, extensible
slides.notes: Summarize mission and immediate value proposition. Stress non-custodial and auditable nature.

slides.title: Problem Statement
content: Constant monitoring required (risk, liquidations, yield shifts)
Manual scripts & teams are slow and error-prone
Institutional treasuries need compliance & auditability
Existing bots are single-purpose and brittle
slides.notes: Use an example: a leveraged position that could be rescued if monitored 24/7; manual teams miss windows leading to avoidable losses.

slides.title: Solution Overview
content: Off-chain AI agents propose actions; on-chain smart contracts enforce policies
Agent types: Risk Manager, Yield Optimizer, Liquidation Agent, Treasury Manager
Governance & multisig for high-impact actions; capability tokens for delegated actions
slides.notes: Explain the separation of concerns: agents propose, contracts enforce. This enables automation while preserving custody and governance.

slides.title: Product Overview — Hero & Value
content: Hero: 'The AI Operating System for On-Chain Finance'
Quick stats: TVL managed, average yield uplift, uptime (placeholders)
CTA: Request demo / Connect org wallet
slides.notes: Explain quick conversion-focused elements and metrics we will use to build credibility.

content: Home: Hero, metrics, audits, demo CTA

slides.title: User Journey — Protocol Operator
content: Discover → Demo → Configure → Simulate → Approve (multisig) → Deploy → Monitor
slides.notes: Focus on governance-first flows: how a protocol operator would authorize and monitor agents.

slides.title: Complete Architecture
content: UI → API → Orchestrator → Agents → Relayer → HashKey Chain Contracts → Data Lake
Indexers, Oracles, Model Serving, Relayer, Smart Contracts
slides.notes: Walk the data flow and control flow. Indexer → Agents → Proposal → Policy → Execution.

slides.title: AI Architecture
content: Risk Manager, Yield Optimizer, Liquidator, Treasury Manager
Training: offline labeling, retraining cycles; Serving: Triton/TorchServe
Safety: simulation, deterministic guardrails, explainability
slides.notes: Explain how models and rule-based systems combine.

slides.title: Security & Competitive Analysis
content: Security: Timelocks, multisig, capability tokens, oracle aggregation, HSM/KMS
Competitive differentiation: composable agents, enterprise-first, governance
